name: hover-card-26
description: Short commit hashes in a deploy log that preview the commit message and author.

files.content:
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { HoverCard, HoverCardContent, HoverCardTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/hover-card" const deploys = [ { sha: "a3f91c2", message: "Cache pricing blocks on the edge", author: "Ali Imam", initials: "AI", when: "12 min ago", env: "Production", }, { sha: "7be02d4", message: "Bump image optimizer to v3", author: "Studio Developer", initials: "SD", when: "1 hr ago", env: "Preview", }, ] export default function CommitHashHoverCard() { return (
{deploys.map((d) => (
{d.env} {d.sha}

{d.message}

{d.initials} {d.author} committed {d.when}
))}
) }
